messages.content: Hi! Weekly check-in. How have you been?
not great. my ride broke down. pharmacy is 40 mins away and i'm out of my blood pressure meds
That's tough. I can't help with rides or refills, but our nurse team can—want me to escalate? Median response is 31 hours.
yes please. also been dizzy since i stopped them
Escalating now. Tell them about the dizziness. Any BP reading handy?
Logged (150/94). That helps the nurse see the picture. They'll call/text within 31 hours with access resources.

theme: the long drive to the pharmacy or clinic, transport
